steps.en: Officer can open a court application report
steps.id: Officer bisa membuka report court application
steps.why_en: The court report menu is an empty placeholder.
steps.why_id: Menu report court hanya kerangka kosong.

steps.en: Report lists the successfully updated notices
steps.id: Report mencantumkan notice yang berhasil di-update
steps.why_en: A general MHA report exists, not one limited to court application notices.
steps.why_id: Ada report MHA umum, bukan khusus notice court application.

steps.en: A report file is produced for the officer to refer to
steps.id: File report dibuat supaya officer bisa merujuk
steps.why_en: Email delivery is switched off in the production settings; blob storage access is unclear.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman email dimatikan di setelan produksi; akses penyimpanan belum jelas.

steps.en: Officer views the report in the staff portal
steps.id: Officer melihat report di portal staf
steps.why_en: Only the general MHA report can be viewed; the court report menu is empty.
steps.why_id: Hanya report MHA umum yang bisa dilihat; menu report court kosong.
